collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-02  -  THE BROKEN WATER JAR SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: A young apprentice accidentally cracks a communal water jar while moving supplies, and nobody sees what happened.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A young apprentice accidentally cracks a communal water jar while moving supplies, and nobody sees what happened.

choices.label: Quietly Attempt a Repair Before Reporting It.
Leave a Note Beside the Jar.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The keeper is disappointed but appreciates the honesty and helps arrange a repair.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The apprentice spends the afternoon replacing the damaged jar's bindings.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The repair holds, and the apprentice explains both the accident and the work afterward.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The crack spreads, reminding the apprentice why damaged containers should be reported promptly.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The friend accompanies the apprentice to the keeper, making the admission less frightening.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The friend offers to take responsibility, but the apprentice declines and tells the truth.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The keeper reads the explanation and asks the apprentice to help inspect the damage.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The note is overlooked, and the apprentice realizes a direct conversation is still needed.
